newsitem.title: USA: United Dominion Realty in 5 property deals.
newsitem.headline: United Dominion Realty in 5 property deals.

text.p: United Dominion Realty Trust Inc said Thursday it bought three apartment communities for about $30.2 million and sold two other properties for $14.7 million.

The trust bought a 274-home apartment property in Tampa, Fla., where it plans to initially spend about $1 million for upkeep. United Dominion also bought a 304-home community in Dallas and a 272-home community in Houston.

United Dominion said it sold a 544-home apartment community in Houston and a 188,000 square-feet shopping center in Hampton, Va., for a $3 million capital gain. It said it would defer the gain for income tax purposes.
The trust also said it completed the $4.6 million construction and lease-up of 80 homes in Euless, a suburb of Dallas.
Shares in United Dominion Realty fell 3/16 to 14-9/16.
